title: session/log
description: Method `session/log`: a paginated slice of a session's append-only JSONL log, by line range, so a client can page backward through a long transcript over a tunnel without reading the daemon's disk.

offset.description: First line to return (0-based); defaults to 0.

limit.description: Maximum lines to return; defaults to a daemon-chosen page size.

total.description: Total number of lines in the log.

offset.description: Offset of the first returned line.

lines.description: The raw JSONL lines in [offset, offset + lines.length).
